What is cash-on-cash return? Your return on the money you actually put in.

Rent comes in, costs go out, the bank takes its mortgage. What's left is your cash flow. Divide it by the cash you put in (down payment + closing costs).

Same $300K house: paid all cash 6.5%, with 25% down at 7%: 1.8%.

It tells you what your money actually earns. dealcaddie.ai
